en.headline: Hong Kong Philharmonic postpones Symphony Under the Stars to Saturday
en.dek: The outdoor concert at the Central Harbourfront, originally set for Friday evening, is delayed until 7:30pm on Saturday because of expected showers and thunderstorms.
body: The Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra has postponed its annual outdoor concert, Swire Symphony Under the Stars, from Friday evening to Saturday at the same time.

The organisers said the delay was due to the Hong Kong Observatory's forecast of increasing showers and isolated squally thunderstorms on Friday night. The event, held at the Central Harbourfront, will now take place at 7:30pm on 14 November. Ticket holders may use their original tickets for entry.

This is the second time in recent years the outdoor performance has been affected by weather. In 2024, heavy rain forced the concert to end early after only two pieces. The programme this year features the orchestra's new music director and includes works such as Saint-Saëns' Carnival of the Animals and Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture with fireworks.
The orchestra advised the public to check its website and social media channels for the latest updates.

zh.headline: 港樂因天氣將星夜交響曲延至周六舉行
zh.dek: 原訂周五晚於中環海濱舉行的戶外音樂會，因預料驟雨及狂風雷暴，改期至周六晚上7時30分，原有門票仍然有效。
body: 香港管弦樂團宣布，原定周五晚上於中環海濱舉行的太古「港樂．星夜．交響曲」戶外音樂會，將延期至周六同一時間舉行。
主辦單位表示，因天文台預測今晚驟雨增多及有幾陣狂風雷暴，故作出改期決定。活動將於11月14日晚上7時30分在中環海濱舉行，持票人士可憑原有門票進場。
這並非首次受天氣影響。2024年11月的同類活動曾因大雨在演奏兩首樂曲後腰斫。今年節目由港樂新任音樂總監帶領，包括聖桑《動物嘉年華》及柴可夫斯基《1812序曲》配煙花等。
港樂呼籲市民留意其網站及社交媒體的最新消息。
